the-american-goliah: This anonymous pamphlet tells the story of the Cardiff Giant — the ten-foot stone man unearthed in New York in 1869 that fooled thousands. The great American hoax is recounted with all its humbug and humor. A delightful chapter in the history of gullibility.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-allah: A 1913 entry on Allah — the Islamic name of God. Romain Butin explains its meaning and use. The Koran's God is one and merciful. Christians and Muslims share the word. A bridge-word between the faiths. Its call sounds from every minaret.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-amrah: This 1913 reference piece on Amrah — a name in the Christian archaeology. Henri Leclercq notes its record. The entry preserves the scanty notice. The old stones keep their secrets. A footnote to the catacombs. Its notice aids the archaeologists. Its stones await the spade.
